description: Use this when the user wants one resume bullet rewritten or made stronger. Check one resume bullet with the fixed rules (score, verdict, fixes) and suggest up to three stronger rewrites that keep every fact as given. ask_user names the one fact to ask the user for; never invent it. Part of the answer is drafted by an AI model (Gemma 4, with Llama 3.3 70B as a backup, on Cloudflare Workers AI) behind ATSPrep's guard, which drops any figure, name or tool the user's text doesn't contain. If the AI part is unavailable, the rule-based part still comes back and ai.message says why.

company.description: Optional. The employer this bullet sits under.

role.description: Optional. The job title this bullet sits under.

name: improve_bullet
title: Improve a resume bullet
